description: This PHP script handles AJAX callbacks for activity reminders in the Calendar module of a CRM system (likely Vtiger CRM). It processes actions such as postponing reminders by updating database records accordingly.

methods.name: LoggerManager::getLogger
methods.description: Retrieves a logger instance for logging activities related to activity reminders.

methods.name: $adb->pquery
methods.description: Executes a parameterized database query to update the status of a reminder record.
